facts.business: Bharat Agri Fert & Realty Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of fertilizers (Super Phosphate) and real estate development.

auditor.name: Desai Saksena & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: (a) Non-provision for old overdue trade receivables of Rs.10.21 Crores; (b) Non-performance of impairment study for Fertiliser Segment PPE despite nil capacity utilisation and significant losses. Emphasis of matter on sub-judice matters: short receipt of TDR (Rs.1.16 Cr) and maintenance charges payable (Rs.0.33 Cr).

key_risks: Non-provision for old overdue trade receivables (Rs.10.21 Cr)
Potential impairment of Fertiliser Segment assets due to nil capacity utilisation and significant losses
Sub-judice matters regarding TDR short receipt (Rs.1.16 Cr) and maintenance charges (Rs.0.33 Cr)
Claims against company not acknowledged as debt (Rs.9.31 Cr)
Dependence on related party transactions and personal guarantees from promoters
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include remuneration to KMPs (Rs.84 lakh each to four directors), rent paid to My Shop (Rs.55.17 lakh), deposits given (Rs.27.59 lakh), and personal guarantees given by promoters (Yogendra D. Patel: Rs.5,396.43 lakh). All transactions stated to be on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business.
